name: Pocket
description: Discontinued Mozilla read-it-later service formerly used for saved articles and reading lists.
agentUseSummary: Pocket cannot be connected or installed because Mozilla shut down the service and permanently disabled its API after the export window closed.

blocked.label: Connect Pocket
blocked.description: Pocket accounts and applications no longer operate.

blocked.label: Use Pocket API
blocked.description: Mozilla disabled the Pocket API on November 12, 2025.

blocked.label: Export Pocket data
blocked.description: The final export window closed and Pocket user data entered permanent deletion on November 12, 2025.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No actions can be enabled for a discontinued provider.

runtimeSupport.description: No Pocket service or API remains available to mount.
No Pocket service or API remains available to mount.

providerSetup.blocker: Pocket shut down on July 8, 2025 and its API was disabled on November 12, 2025.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not request credentials or show Connect. Keep the historical provider unavailable and direct new reading workflows to a supported provider selected separately by the user.

evidence.supports: Mozilla states that Pocket shut down on July 8, 2025, the API and export mode were disabled on November 12, 2025, and user data entered permanent deletion.
Pocket's former product site now presents the service retirement rather than an operational application or developer API.
